releases.body:
Put the peak mark beside the GO heading

The name carried a minimum width written for the wallet rows, and GO is
shorter than it: fourteen pixels of nothing between the heading and the
mark. The mark says you are paying double, so it reads as part of the name.


Record: docs/oc-budget.md

Keep a countdown under every bar

At a window's turn the endpoint answers without the reset date and that
answer is cached, so the row vanished and read as a bug: it now says
`now`. The popover ends it at the bar's own edge, where the reset lands.


Record: docs/oc-budget.md

Draw the budget report as the sidebar it replaces

/budget existed for a hidden panel and had drifted from the one surface
that shows the same figures. It now shares the bars, the colours and the
arrow's side, and the number nobody could read is gone.


Record: docs/oc-budget.md
